chk_cloth_sales_client_or_guest.name: chk_cloth_sales_client_or_guest
chk_cloth_sales_client_or_guest.value: "cloth_sales"."client_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("cloth_sales"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL AND "cloth_sales"."guest_name" <> '') OR ("cloth_sales"."client_id" IS NULL AND "cloth_sales"."guest_name" IS NULL)

chk_pedido_lines_kind.name: chk_pedido_lines_kind
chk_pedido_lines_kind.value:
("pedido_lines"."kind" = 'garment'
          AND "pedido_lines"."cloth_piece_variant_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."amount" IS NULL)
        OR ("pedido_lines"."kind" = 'adjustment'
          AND "pedido_lines"."cloth_piece_variant_id" IS NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."unit_price" IS NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."amount" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."price_reason" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."color_id" IS NULL
          AND "pedido_lines"."color_other" IS NULL)

chk_pedidos_destination_client.name: chk_pedidos_destination_client
chk_pedidos_destination_client.value:
("pedidos"."destination" = 'client' AND "pedidos"."client_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pedidos"."destination" = 'inventory' AND "pedidos"."client_id" IS NULL)

chk_stock_movements_reason.name: chk_stock_movements_reason
chk_stock_movements_reason.value: "stock_movements"."kind" NOT IN ('adjustment', 'scrap', 'restructure') OR "stock_movements"."reason" IS NOT NULL

chk_ticket_items_override_reason.name: chk_ticket_items_override_reason
chk_ticket_items_override_reason.value: "ticket_items"."override_price" IS NULL OR ("ticket_items"."override_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_items"."override_reason" <> '')

chk_tickets_client_or_guest.name: chk_tickets_client_or_guest
chk_tickets_client_or_guest.value: "tickets"."client_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("tickets"."guest_name" IS NOT NULL AND "tickets"."guest_name" <> '')
